resources.string: Sync completed workouts from the last 7 days that Mi Fitness or another app shared with Health Connect.
Sync previews workouts. Confirm a session to log its duration and available active calories. Sessions of at least 5 elapsed minutes can earn progress and rewards. Elapsed time can include pauses.
No workouts found in this 7-day window. Check that your source app shared workouts with Health Connect.
Couldn’t update workouts. Previous results are still shown.
View activity log for this date
Possible time overlap with a guided workout. Review before logging this activity again.
A counted manual activity exists on one of these dates. Its exact times are unavailable, so this is not a confirmed duplicate.
Possible time overlap with another imported record. These may describe the same workout or legitimate overlapping sessions.
Comparison with your existing logs is unavailable. Imported workouts still remain separate and uncounted.
Available active calories are counted after you confirm the workout.
Imported cache removed. Original Health Connect and Mi Fitness records were not deleted.

1. Start the same activity on your band within 30 minutes.
2. Finish on the band and let Mi Fitness sync to Health Connect.
3. Tap Sync here and confirm the matching workout.

FitnessBalance does not control the band or show live readings.

Save workout details, elapsed duration and available active calories to your account’s activity log. Missing calories are excluded from totals.

Confirm only if you haven’t logged this workout manually. Overlapping logged guided or wearable workouts are blocked.

Eligible sessions can earn quest and achievement progress. Wearable base XP and weekly credit are limited to once per workout date.
Active calories unavailable (%1$s). Check access and source app exports. Daily or total calories are never substituted.
Sync again before recording. The workout snapshot must be less than 5 minutes old.
Workout recorded. Eligible progress and rewards were updated.
Calorie total is partial: a wearable workout has unavailable calories. Its duration is recorded.
Already recorded: %1$d XP. No extra XP added.
Workout saved. Rewards require at least five elapsed minutes and a session starting within the last seven days. Calories are not required.
Wearable base XP and weekly credit have already been awarded for this workout date. Other sessions still record duration and calories.

Wearable policy v1: 20 base XP and one weekly credit per workout date, plus unclaimed daily quest bonuses. Calories never determine XP. Guided lesson paths and feedback achievements require their own actions.
Remove this wearable entry from calorie and duration totals? Earned XP, quest completions, achievements and weekly credit remain recorded. Its confirmation receipt prevents re-import.
